text.tspan: Share of girls and boys who are not in primary school
Share of girls and boys of primary school age (typically 6–11 years) not enrolled in primary education, expressed
as a percentage of the total population of girls and boys in that age group.
Data source: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (2026)
